name: Lauren Boebert
summary: Boebert advocates lower taxes, reduced federal regulation, gun rights, strict border enforcement and an America First foreign policy. She opposes abortion and same-sex marriage, promotes Christian influence in public life, and supports expanding domestic energy production.
